philosophy: jorm.objects exists at the intersection of craft and concept. Every piece begins with a material — its weight, its grain, its willingness to be shaped — and a question about how objects occupy space.
We believe in structural honesty: nothing decorative that doesn't serve, nothing hidden that should be seen. Our work embraces tension, asymmetry, and the beauty of visible construction.
process: Each project begins with material studies and hand sketches before moving to prototyping. We work directly with fabricators and artisans, maintaining hands-on involvement from concept through final production.
Limited editions and one-offs are produced in our workshop. Production pieces are manufactured in partnership with small-batch facilities across Northern Europe.
